package.name: armv7_impedance_moveit
package.description: v0.1 STARTER PACKAGE for 6-DoF Cartesian impedance / admittance control with MoveIt on the armv7 arm. This release ships the *interface contract* (header structs, planned topics / services / params), a README explaining what the v0.2 implementation must do, and a TODO file enumerating the work — but NO control loop yet. The package builds clean so downstream code can compile against the interface today. See README and TODO.md.
